workflow_rationale: This is a greenfield feature build introducing an entirely new subsystem (node engine) into Mascarade. It requires architecture design, plugin system scaffolding, UI implementation (ReactFlow), and execution runtime development across multiple technology domains.

phases.name: Execution Runtime
phases.description: Build the graph execution engine with topological sort, execution context, and node runner supporting both sync and async execution models.

subtasks.description: Create GraphExecutor with topological sort and cycle detection
subtasks.notes:
GraphExecutor successfully implemented with topological sort and cycle detection.

**Implementation:**
- Created GraphExecutor.ts with Kahn's algorithm for topological sorting
- Detects and rejects cyclic graphs (throws error with node details)
- Comprehensive validation (duplicate IDs, invalid edges, cycles)
- Additional helper methods: getDependencies, getDependents, hasCycle, getRootNodes, getLeafNodes
- Advanced features: getExecutionDepth and getExecutionLevels for parallel execution analysis

**Testing:**
- Created comprehensive test suite with 18 test cases
- Tests cover: linear graphs, diamond graphs, disconnected nodes, empty graphs
- Cycle detection tests: simple cycles, self-loops, complex cycles
- Validation tests: invalid edges, duplicate node IDs
- All 18 tests pass successfully

**Verification:**
✓ All tests pass (18/18)
✓ Topological sort works correctly for DAGs
✓ Cycles detected and rejected with clear error messages
✓ Code follows TypeScript strict mode patterns
✓ No console.log debugging statements

subtasks.description: Create ExecutionContext for message passing and state management
subtasks.notes:
ExecutionContext successfully implemented for isolated execution state management.

**Implementation:**
- Created ExecutionContextManager class for creating isolated execution contexts
- Each context provides shared state map for message passing between nodes within same run
- Complete isolation between concurrent graph executions (different runIds)
- Logging support with multiple levels (debug, info, warn, error)
- Real-time event emission for WebSocket updates (state changes, logs)
- Abort signal support for execution cancellation via AbortController
- Cleanup methods to prevent memory leaks after execution completes

**Testing:**
- Created comprehensive test suite with 28 test cases
- Tests cover: context creation, state isolation, logging, event emission
- Abort signal handling and cleanup functionality
- Concurrent execution isolation verified with 100 parallel runs
- All 28 tests pass successfully

**Key Features:**
- Concurrent executions maintain isolated state via unique runId
- Nodes within same run share state Map for message passing (Node-RED pattern)
- Event emitter pushes real-time updates to UI (WebSocket ready)
- AbortController integration for cancellable executions
- Memory-safe with proper cleanup methods (getActiveRuns, cleanup, cleanupAll)

**Verification:**
✓ All 28 tests pass
✓ Concurrent execution isolation works correctly
✓ Message passing between nodes via shared state
✓ Event emission for real-time UI updates
✓ Abort signal propagation across nodes in same run
✓ No console.log debugging statements

Committed: e7c5072

subtasks.description: Create NodeRunner wrapper for individual node execution (sync/async handling)
subtasks.notes:
NodeRunner successfully implemented with comprehensive features:

**Implementation:**
- Sync/async execution support (handles both Promise and synchronous execute returns)
- Execution timeout enforcement using Promise.race with timeout and abort promises
- Input validation: required ports, default values, custom plugin validation
- State emission: pending → running → complete/error for real-time UI updates
- Abort signal handling for execution cancellation
- Performance tracking: duration, startedAt, completedAt timestamps
- Lifecycle hooks: onInit and onDestroy support (both sync and async)
- Structured error handling with ExecutionError
- Comprehensive logging at all stages

**Testing:**
- Created comprehensive test suite with 23 test cases
- Tests cover: sync execution, async execution, timeout enforcement
- Input validation (required, defaults, custom validation, skip validation)
- Error handling (Error objects, non-Error throws, structured errors)
- Abort signal handling (during execution, before start)
- Performance tracking (duration on success and error)
- Lifecycle hooks (onInit, onDestroy, async hooks, optional hooks)
- All 23 tests pass successfully

**Files Created:**
- api/src/node-engine/runtime/NodeRunner.ts - Core implementation
- api/src/node-engine/runtime/__tests__/NodeRunner.test.ts - Test suite

**Key Features:**
- Normalizes execution results using helper from NodePluginAPI
- Properly handles both sync (low-latency audio/logic) and async (AI/network I/O) execution models
- Race condition handling: timeout vs execution vs abort signal
- Follows Max/MSP pattern: sync for audio paths, async for I/O operations
- Integration ready: emits events for WebSocket real-time updates

**Verification:**
✓ All 23 tests pass
✓ TypeScript compiles without errors
✓ Handles both sync and async execute functions correctly
✓ Properly validates inputs and applies default values
✓ Enforces timeouts using Promise.race
✓ Emits correct state transitions (pending → running → complete/error)
✓ Tracks performance metrics accurately
✓ Handles abort signals from ExecutionContext
✓ No console.log debugging statements
